title: What the Car‑Guys "G" Hand Sign Really Means
hook: Car guys flashing a "G" – you’ve seen it, but do you know why?

script.narration: The "G" isn’t a secret code for gossip – it stands for "Good Gear." When a driver shifts into the optimal gear for speed or fuel efficiency, they give a quick thumbs‑up shaped like a G. It’s a way to say, "I'm in the right gear, keep up!" Knowing this lets you read traffic flow better and avoid unnecessary revving. Next time you spot the sign, match their pace or shift up to stay in sync and save fuel.
